rubric.evidence: Every load-bearing claim traced to a primary source fetched 2026-11-15: Web Audio API index.bs and published Editor's Draft (OfflineAudioContext IDL with startRendering(optional unsigned long? chunkSize = null), close(), nullable length; startRendering(chunkSize) and begin-offline-rendering algorithms; close() algorithm; privacy considerations), PR #2675, the MSEdgeExplainers explainer, Chromium offline_audio_context.idl (two overloads + TODO crbug 530596178), offline_audio_context_options.idl, offline_audio_context.cc (CalculateEffectiveChunkSize, zero-chunk and too-large NotSupportedError, OnChunkRendered, closeContext/OnRenderStopped, AbortError rejection), runtime_enabled_features.json5 (status stable), base_audio_context.h (32-channel max), and the three WPT files (incremental-rendering, data-integrity, close).

Feature id 5109900936085504 is in the milestone=158 listing under 'Enabled by default' (fetched 2026-11-15); slug offlineaudiocontext-incremental-rendering is the listing name 'OfflineAudioContext incremental rendering' slugified; H1 uses the listing name. ChromeStatus ship stage lists desktop/Android/WebView 158 and the runtime flag is stable, so no warn-block is required (not OT/dev-trial/flagged).

Five inventory items: startRendering(chunkSize) and close() each get a child route with all nine dimensions; the nullable OfflineAudioContextOptions.length and nullable length attribute share an undefined-length child route; the chunked rendering model (bufferLength table, committed/rendered frames, queueing, auto-close, complete-event firing) is documented on the overview. Unchanged IDL members quoted for context are listed in outOfScope with rationales.

Two spec/implementation divergences are called out explicitly rather than smoothed over: the spec text rounds the final chunk up past length while Chromium and WPT trim it, and the spec queues complete after each finite chunk while Chromium fires it once with the final chunk. The explainer's Infinity spelling is flagged as not shipped (null is).

Finite chunked export with fallback, open-ended render with close, pipelined chunk generator, cancel button with AbortError handling, try/finally cleanup, nullable-length feature detection. Expected buffer lengths match WPT arithmetic. Examples were not executed in this environment; the showcase concept demo embedded below exercises the API live.

close() row is from BCD api.OfflineAudioContext.close (Chrome 158, Firefox/Safari false, mirrors for Edge/Android/WebView). BCD has no key for chunkSize or length:null; those rows are labelled interim ChromeStatus data. webstatus.dev reports limited availability; Baseline banner says Limited availability. Feature detection via OfflineAudioContext.prototype.close with fallback code shown.

Every citation label links to its original (spec anchors verified present in the published ED, googlesource files, WPT blobs, BCD JSON, webstatus.dev API, ChromeStatus API, blink-dev intent msgid links, standards-positions issues, TAG review). CPS feature route and all four concept routes HEAD-checked 200 on 2026-11-15; MDN close() page 404 and startRendering page lacks chunkSize (MDN check -> generate).

Single h1 per page with soft hyphens in long member names, sequential h2/h3 outline, th scope on tables, table captions, scrollable table wrappers made focusable (tabindex=0, role=region, aria-label) with a visible focus ring, baseline banner role=note with aria-label, iframe title + figcaption.

All tables inside .table-wrap (shared overflow-x:auto scroller), pre blocks scroll internally, iframe max-width:100%, shared overflow-wrap rules for long identifiers; checked with headless Chrome at 1280x800 and 360x740 DPR3 and the repo responsive matrix.

Embeds the chunked-render-console concept route (200) with the mandated sandbox/referrerpolicy pair and loading=lazy; links the lifecycle-and-close, memory-math and wav-export-pipeline concept routes; cpsFeature conformance route points at the parent feature suite whose release/featureSlug/chromestatusId match this page.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive data table on mobile without horizontal page overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Semantic table with th headers and caption; wrap in an overflow:auto container that is keyboard-focusable (tabindex=0) with role=region and an accessible name.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: every table is inside .table-wrap with tabindex=0, role=region and aria-label, has th scope and (for data tables) a caption, and a visible :focus-visible ring. Exception: the stacked-card container-query transform was not used; the shared .table-wrap scroller keeps the page itself from overflowing and the tables are at most seven columns.

guidanceConsulted.query: defer offscreen iframe embed loading lazy
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use native loading="lazy" for below-the-fold iframes; give them a title.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: the showcase iframe sits in the Examples section below the fold with loading="lazy", explicit width/height and a title; no third-party scripts are loaded by the page.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Prefer semantic HTML with accessible names; do not rely on colour alone.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: the Baseline banner is role=note with aria-label, the status is text ('Limited availability'), and unsupported browsers are labelled in text, not only by the muted colour.

guidanceConsulted.query: long code blocks and identifiers wrapping on narrow mobile screens
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Keep headings legible and avoid layout breakage from long tokens.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: soft hyphens (­) in the long child-page h1 member names; shared overflow-wrap rules from public/styles.css handle inline code; pre blocks scroll horizontally inside their own box.

openQuestions: The spec algorithm as written rounds the final chunk of a finite render up past length and queues the complete event after every finite chunk; Chromium and WPT trim the final chunk and fire complete once. Whether the spec text will be corrected (or Chromium changed) is not yet recorded in a public issue found during research.
BCD has no subfeature for the chunkSize argument or for length: null; the interim compat rows depend on ChromeStatus ship data.
Whether Chrome 158 stable shipped with the runtime feature at status stable on the release branch is inferred from trunk + the ChromeStatus ship stage; the release-branch json5 was not fetched.

followUpGoals.goal: When BCD adds keys for the startRendering chunkSize parameter or a null OfflineAudioContextOptions.length, replace the interim ChromeStatus rows on the overview, start-rendering and undefined-length pages with BCD-anchored rows.

Track the Web Audio spec for a fix to the final-chunk rounding and per-chunk complete-event wording; update the divergence notes on the overview and start-rendering pages when the spec text or Chromium behaviour changes.

When Firefox or Safari ship OfflineAudioContext.close()/chunked rendering (mozilla/standards-positions #1456, WebKit/standards-positions #724), update the Baseline banner and compat tables from webstatus.dev and BCD.
Execute the documented examples (pipelined generator, cancel button, nullable-length detection) in Chrome 158 and record the observed buffer lengths and rejection names in this critique.
